_comment: Community-maintained data for games whose Discord detectable entry no longer ships the 'executables' field. 'steam_app_id' + 'install_dir' + 'exe_names' mirror what SteamDB lists for the game (see https://steamdb.info/app/<steam_app_id>/config/). See GitHub issue #48 for background.

overrides.name: Marathon
overrides.note: Verified working in issue #48 (Mar-2026). Marathon.exe is the game binary, MarathonLauncher.exe is Steam's default launch option.

overrides.name: Enginefall
overrides.note: From SteamDB launch options (Jul-2026). Install dir is the internal codename 'Coltrane'.
